reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Spec.Assumption22.mk
Paper notion: the constructor of the Lean structure encoding Assumption 2.2 (see the reading of
Spec.Assumption22): building the assumption from its components, xi_0 in L^2(Omega,F_0;R^n) and the
origin-value integrability of b, sigma, h, f at (0,delta_0) on [0,T].
Faithful iff its argument list is exactly the fields of a faithful Assumption22 (no extra
hypotheses, none missing), i.e. the constructor type is
  (xi_0 F_0-measurable and in L^2) -> (origin values in L^2(0,T)) -> Assumption22 ...

comparison.text:
Comparison: constructor Spec.Assumption22.mk vs locked reading.
Its arguments are exactly the three fields of Assumption22, StronglyMeasurable[ℱ 0] ξ₀ (the
pretty-printed signature shows StronglyMeasurable ξ₀; the constructor's argument type is the
field type, which carries [ℱ 0]), MemLp ξ₀ 2 P and OriginValues T C, and it returns Assumption22
ℱ P T C ξ₀. Nothing extra, nothing missing. Its meaning is that of Assumption22.
Verdict: faithful with representation choices (those of Assumption22).

verdict.detail:
Representation choices, each harmless:
1. ξ₀ ∈ L²(Ω,F_0;ℝⁿ) is encoded as a function Ω → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) that is strongly
   ℱ_0-measurable and MemLp 2 P: every L²(F_0) class has such a representative, and the system
   uses ξ₀ as a function.
2. The origin-value conditions are imposed on Lebesgue measure restricted to the open interval
   (0,T) (in OriginValues) instead of [0,T]: the endpoints are Lebesgue-null, so L²(0,T) is the
   same space.
